phrases.say: I T C's share fell from four hundred and nine rupees to two hundred and fifty three, in ten months.
Let's cut the factory open and see why.
Last quarter, thirty thousand crore rupees of sales came in through the roof.
The sorter splits it four ways.
Cigarettes. F M C G. Agri. And paper.
Floor two, the cigarette press. Fifteen thousand five hundred crore of sales.
But since February, every stick pays a new excise duty, on top of forty percent G S T.
Cigarette profit fell twenty seven percent, to three thousand eight hundred crore.
Yet this one floor still earns about three quarters of the profit.
Floor three, the packing line. Atta, biscuits, chips.
Floor four, agri. Profit up eleven percent.
Floor five, the paper mill. Profit up forty eight percent, helped by a mill it bought in August.
And the hotels? A crane lifted them out.
I T C Hotels became a separate company in January twenty twenty five. I T C kept forty percent.
Everything lands in the vault. Four thousand one hundred crore of profit, down twenty percent.
The share is three hundred and one rupees today.
Can the new floors grow fast enough to carry the old one?
